definitions: A person who takes part in an undertaking with another or others, especially in a business or company with shared risks and profits.
Either of a pair of people who are married or in a romantic relationship.
One of a pair of dancers or players on the same side in a game.
A person or thing that is associated with another in a particular activity or sphere of interest.
examples: She became a partner in the law firm.
My partner and I are going on holiday.
He needs a new partner for the dance competition.
The company is looking for a technology partner.
